Claude is Anthropic's AI assistant with advanced reasoning capabilities.
Models: see ClaudeClient.VALID_MODELS and the provider's default_model_id. This field deliberately does not list them. It carried a "Latest Models (October 2025)" block naming Sonnet 4.5, Haiku 4.5 and Opus 4.1 long after those stopped being latest, because a description loaded noupdate="1" is written once and read for years while the model line moves every few months. A fourth copy of the model list, and the one nothing could correct.
Features: - 1M token context window on current models - Vision capabilities (images, PDFs, base64, URLs) - Adaptive thinking for complex reasoning - Tool use for structured outputs and function calling - Guaranteed valid JSON via tool use (structured_output method) - JSON parsed from a text answer (json_completion method) - Prompt caching for optimized repeated context usage
For current pricing information, visit: https://www.anthropic.com/pricing
Use Cases: - Complex agent building and automation - Code generation and review - Document understanding and summarization (vision + PDF) - Agentic workflows with tool use - Multi-turn conversations with vision - Data extraction with structured_output (production) - Simple JSON with json_completion (quick tasks) - Complex reasoning with adaptive thinking
ClaudeClient Methods (Phase 1 - Quick Wins): - create_message() - Full API control with vision, thinking, tools - simple_completion() - Quick text generation - vision_completion() - Analyze images - structured_output() - Guaranteed JSON with schema validation - json_completion() - JSON parsed from a text answer - vision_structured_output() - Extract data from images - streaming_completion() - Stream responses - get_usage() - Track token usage
ClaudeClient Methods (Phase 2 - Advanced): - create_cacheable_content() - Create cached content blocks - create_cached_system_prompt() - Cached system prompts for optimization - tool_conversation() - Agentic workflows with tool use
ClaudeClient Methods (Phase 3 - PDF Support): - pdf_completion() - Analyze PDF documents (text, tables, charts) - pdf_structured_output() - Extract validated data from PDFs - pdf_with_caching() - Multi-question PDF analysis with optimization
Real-World Use Cases: - Chatbots with cached guidelines (optimized token usage) - AI agents that query Odoo database (tool use) - Full module code analysis (extended context) - Invoice OCR with structured extraction (vision + structured output) - PDF invoice/contract processing (pdf_structured_output) - Multi-step workflows (tool conversation) - Document understanding at scale (extended context + caching) - Batch PDF processing (100s of documents) - Interactive PDF Q&A (pdf_with_caching)

DeepSeek provides powerful AI models for various tasks.
Models: see the provider's gateway.ml.model rows and default_model_id. This field deliberately does not list them by name, after service_anthropic's description carried a hardcoded model list that aged badly in a noupdate="1" record. DeepSeek has no vision-capable model or OCR support in this client.
Features: - Thinking mode, switched per request (off for chat, on for reasoning_completion) - Enhanced agent capabilities - OpenAI-compatible API format - Function calling / tool use support - JSON mode for structured output - Excellent for mathematical and coding tasks - MIT License (model is open-source)
For current pricing information, visit: https://platform.deepseek.com/
DeepSeekClient Methods: - chat_completion() - Full API control with messages - simple_completion() - Quick text generation - streaming_completion() - Stream responses in real-time - structured_output() - Guaranteed JSON with schema validation via function calling - json_completion() - JSON parsed from a text answer - get_usage() - Token usage tracking - reasoning_completion() - Complex reasoning with thinking mode on - tool_conversation() - Multi-turn agentic workflows with function calling
Use Cases: - Code generation and analysis - Mathematical reasoning - Structured data extraction (structured_output) - AI agents with Odoo integration (tool_conversation) - Bulk text processing - Technical documentation - Code review and analysis - Long conversation workflows
When to Use DeepSeek vs Claude: - Use DeepSeek for: Math, coding, bulk operations - Use Claude for: Vision/OCR, native PDF processing, extremely complex reasoning - Use Both: DeepSeek for general tasks, Claude for advanced features requiring vision/PDFs
Limitations: - No vision or OCR capability - No native PDF processing - No batch API

Industry-leading speech recognition and audio intelligence platform.
Core Capabilities: - Speech-to-Text: Pre-recorded and real-time streaming transcription - Text-to-Speech: Natural voice synthesis with multiple voices - Audio Intelligence: Summarization, sentiment, topics, entities, intents - Multi-language: Support for 30+ languages with code-switching - Speaker Diarization: Identify and separate different speakers
Key Features: - Multiple transcription models for different use cases - Advanced audio intelligence and insights - PII redaction and content filtering - Custom vocabulary and keyword boosting - Real-time WebSocket streaming - High accuracy with low latency - Enterprise-grade reliability
Use Cases: - Call center analytics and quality monitoring - Meeting transcription and insights - Media and podcast transcription - Voice-enabled applications - Compliance and legal documentation
For current features, models, and pricing: https://deepgram.com API Documentation: https://developers.deepgram.com/docs
